name: Shinonome Ichika
source: Protagonist. The daughter of a doctor father and secretary mother who often have to travel for work, leaving her alone. As class president, she is well-liked, and has a reputation as a serious student who intends on following in her father's footsteps and becoming a doctor. Her life is thrown into disarray following the discovery of her close friend Tadehara Hitomi's body following her suicide.
